replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I never studied math formally, so I don’t have a strong academic connection to it. I’m more comfortable with stories and nature than numbers.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: No, I don’t get anxious about math. I’ve never had to do complex equations. My anxiety is more about life choices, not math.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I didn’t use AI for math learning. I play games and watch videos about physics, which I find more interesting. I don’t need to learn equations.
